subject: Optimize toolkit: RFP response, pilot credits, and quantization guidance
messages:
From: Ben Lee <ben.lee@rapidware.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-05-20T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: RFP: Optimize toolkit pricing & technical guidance

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for taking a look at our RFP (attached). RapidWare is evaluating a 6–12 month pilot of an inference cost-reduction toolkit — specifically: batching/caching guidance, quantization trade-offs, and a starter pricing path for a 3-month pilot. High level:
- Expected monthly 1.2B tokens (mix of generation and embeddings)
- Latency requirement: p95 < 350ms for interactive flows
- Security: must support VPC/private deployment for sensitive predicates

Questions we need addressed in the RFP response:
1) Typical unit pricing shape for the Optimize toolkit during pilot and post-pilot (hosted vs dedicated)
2) Pilot credit options and whether credits apply to Dedicated or only Hosted accounts
3) Recommended quantization regime for quality-sensitive vs background batch tasks (any A/B safety notes)
4) Batching and KV-caching guidance for interactive flows to meet the latency SLO while lowering token cost

We'd like a concise commercial proposal + a short technical appendix and a proposed MAP (mutual action plan). Can you send a draft by EOD Wednesday (5/21)? We plan to run an internal security review next week.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Lee
Head of Platform
RapidWare

Attachment: RW-RFP-2025.pdf (125KB)
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Lee <ben.lee@rapidware.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-05-21T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RFP: Optimize toolkit pricing & technical guidance

Ben — thanks for the clear ask and the RFP. Attached is a focused draft response and a short commercial snapshot. Key highlights up front:

Commercial summary (pilot):
- 3-month pilot credit: $25k in Optimize credits (applies to Hosted & Dedicated pilot usage; see note below)
- Pilot list pricing (hosted): $0.0035 /k tokens (generation) baseline for Optimize-enabled routes; post-pilot discount bands available at commit levels
- Dedicated: flat committed node pricing + 15% discount on optimizer add-on for pilots that commit to a minimum 3-month reserved pool

Technical recommendations (short):
- Quantization: recommend 4-bit LLAMA-style quant for background batch jobs where output acceptance tests exist; keep 8-bit or float16 for user-facing, quality-sensitive prompts. Run A/B on a 5% sample to catch regressions.
- Batching & KV-cache: use continuous batching for background throughput (batch sizes 64–256 depending on seq length). For interactive, enable prefix KV-cache for stable system prompts and set a 100–200 token cache window for conversational sessions to preserve low-latency p95.
- Latency trade-offs: target 200–300ms tail for cached-prefix interactive flows on Dedicated; hosted SLOs are region-dependent.

Open items we need from RapidWare to finalize:
- Typical prompt length distribution and percent of requests that are interactive vs batch
- Clarify whether Dedicated must be behind customer-managed VPC (it can; requires additional infra configuration)
- Any additional compliance docs required beyond standard SOC 2 (e.g., FedRAMP/PEN-testing window)

Proposed next steps:
1) Schedule technical deep-dive with Dylan (SE) and our infra team (30–45m) — we can do Thurs 5/22 or Mon 5/26
2) We'll produce a final commercial MAP and redlines by EOD 5/23 after the deep dive

Attached: RW-RFP-Response-Draft.pdf; pricing-sheet-v3.xlsx (pricing snapshot)

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.ai

Naomi — appreciate the fast turnaround. A few clarifications before we lock a slot:
- Can the pilot credits be used against Dedicated node-hour charges, or only against Hosted per-token charges? If they apply to Dedicated, what's the mechanics?
- For the quantization A/B, can you share an example guardrail-based rollback policy (we're sensitive to hallucination risk)
- Our interactive traffic has a median prompt length ~85 tokens, but tail up to 800 tokens on search-augmented completion. Can you call out any sequence-length-driven pricing adjustments?

We'll take Thurs 5/22 at 11:00 PT for the deep-dive if that still works.

Ben

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>

Date: 2025-05-23T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: RFP: Optimize toolkit pricing & technical guidance (RapidWare)

Internal note — forwarding RapidWare thread and our draft response. They accepted the 11:00 PT slot for Thurs 5/22; Ben asked about Dedicated credit mechanics and a rollback policy for quantized outputs.

Quick proposed commercial approach (internal):
- Approve 3-month pilot: $25k Optimize credits that can be applied to either Hosted per-token charges or to offset Dedicated monthly commit (credits convert at published token-equivalent rate; work with finance to document conversion for SOW).
- If they move to Dedicated commit within 45 days of pilot, offer a one-time 15% accelerator credit on their first 3-month commit (to encourage conversion).

Technical talking points for Dylan to cover on the call:
- Quant rollback: we recommend a two-layer strategy: (1) automated quality gating on a small sampled stream with rollback to float16 on regression detection; (2) conservative rollout (5% → 25% → 100%) with canary metrics (exact-match on golden prompts, top-k consistency, hallucination classifier thresholds).
- Sequence-dependent pricing: propose a blended tier for token pricing where >512 token responses are charged at a 1.25x multiplier for batch routing vs interactive routing (to keep interactive node capacity predictable).

Please add any redlines or operational constraints. Marissa — if you sign off, I'll include this language in the final MAP and confirm pilot credit mechanics with finance.

— Naomi
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Lee <ben.lee@rapidware.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-05-27T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RFP: Optimize toolkit pricing & technical guidance — Final proposal and MAP

Ben — thanks for the conversation last week. Attached is the final proposal and a brief MAP. High-level changes after the call:

Commercial (final):
- Pilot: $25k Optimize credits (applicable to Hosted or to offset Dedicated commit; credits convert to token-equivalent at the published rate and are documented in the SOW)
- Hosted list (Optimize-enabled routes): $0.0035 /k tokens during pilot; post-pilot tiered discounts: 10% at $250k tokens/mo equivalent; 18% at $1M tokens/mo equivalent
- Dedicated: reserved node pricing (SOW) + 15% discount on optimizer add-on for customers who convert to Dedicated within 45 days of pilot completion

Technical appendix (summary):
- Quantization: recommend progressive rollout starting at 4-bit for non-critical batch with A/B safety checks; keep 8-bit/float16 for interactive until canary metrics stable.
- Batching & KV-cache: enable session-level KV cache for interactive flows (100–200 token window). Use dynamic batching for background jobs; cap single-batch seq length to 1024 for cost normalization.
- Latency SLOs: with the recommended config we expect p95 interactive < 350ms on hosted in our primary US region and ~200–300ms on Dedicated nodes sized per pilot traffic.

Mutual action plan (MAP):
1) RapidWare to share representative sample of prompt distribution and a list of sensitive flows (by 6/2)
2) Redwood to deliver implementation playbook + SOW with credit mechanics (by 6/4)
3) 3-month pilot kickoff (target week of 6/9)
4) Weekly syncs and one mid-pilot quality checkpoint on sample prompts

Attachments: RW-RFP-Response-Final.pdf (final commercial + technical appendix), pricing-sheet-v3.xlsx

Approved by: Marissa Cole (Sales Manager) — marissa@redwood.ai

If that plan looks good, I can issue the SOW and pilot credit memo for signature and connect you with our onboarding team for the Dedicated/VPC checklist.

Best regards,
